name: The Brood of Onyxia
summary: Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village does not want a single more whelp of Onyxia to hatch. You are sent to find and destroy the black dragon's eggs near the Wyrmbog, down in the marsh's south.

sections.title: The Eggs in the Wyrmbog
sections.body: Onyxia's brood has been scattered through the Dragonmurk. Draz'Zilb urges haste: the Wyrmbog lies in the south of the marsh, and Draz'Zilb is sure the dragon has made her lair there, with her eggs riddled around it. As long as the land around Stonemaul Village is a nesting place for dragons, the ogres will never take it back, so you are sent to track the eggs down and destroy them.

sections.title: One Last Service
sections.body: With the eggs destroyed, Draz'Zilb says it will be some time before Onyxia can lay more, and thanks you on behalf of the Stonemaul Clan. Then Draz'Zilb asks for one more service. Draz'Zilb judges Mok'Morokk unfit to lead, and Tharg, who would make an excellent leader, is held back by injuries and age. You are asked to drive Mok'Morokk out by force, so that a new leader can bring the clan back to its proper home in the south.

aliases: who gives the brood of onyxia
faq.answer: Draz'Zilb, in Brackenwall Village, sends you out against Onyxia's eggs.

faq.q: Why must the dragon eggs be destroyed?
faq.answer: Draz'Zilb wants no more of Onyxia's whelps to hatch. While the land around Stonemaul Village is a nesting place for dragons, the ogres will never take it back.
Around the Wyrmbog, in the south of the marsh. Draz'Zilb is sure Onyxia has made her lair there.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the broader chain?
aliases: what comes before brood of onyxia 3
faq.answer: It comes after Mok'Morokk refused to act on the news of the brood, when you carried his answer back to Draz'Zilb.
